{{Quote|What happened to the ''satellite'', Chancellor Palpatine?''"<br />"''Even now, it is being dragged to a floating repair yard by tractor beam. A repair yard ''far'' from Coruscant, I should add.|Padmé Amidala and Palpatine|<ref name="fashion">{{TCWComicCite|6.23|Fashion}}</ref>}}
A '''leisure satellite''' operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[leisure satellite]] was [[Mission to the leisure satellite|infiltrated]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] in an attempt to decimate both the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on Coruscant's surface.
